text_simplified: The text discusses a noble hadith that advises playing with children and giving them attention. It mentions the story of the Companion Khalid ibn Sa'id, who used to play with his son. The hadith emphasizes the importance of play in the tarbiyah (upbringing) of children.

review_defects.why: The Arabic explicitly says 'Prophetic hadith' (حديث نبوي), but the English omits 'Prophetic', softening the attribution to the Prophet ﷺ.

The Arabic word التربية means upbringing/education and is not a technical Islamic term requiring transliteration; the title uses 'Tarbiyah' without gloss while the body uses 'tarbiyah (upbringing)', creating inconsistency.
